tables.title: O utput control bits for complementary OCx and OCxN channels with break feature
tables.text_helper: Table 92, "O utput control bits for complementary OCx and OCxN channels with break feature", in section 20.5.9 (TIM15 capture/compare enable register (TIM15_CCER)) on page 598. Columns: Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, Control bits, Output states(1), Output states(1). 12 data row(s). Notes: 1. When both outputs of a channel are not used (control taken over by GPIO controller), the OISx, OISxN, CCxP and CCxNP bits must be kept cleared.
